name: Dwurrindaine: The Widow's Swamp
source:
[b]Dwurrindaine: The Widow's Swamp[/b] is my new game project, which will take place in a fictional fantasy world where you will take on the role of Lord Protector. You are entrusted with the management of one remote settlement Dwurrindaine, which in the language of the Dwarves means Widow's Swamp. This is one of the most dangerous, dead and unexplored territories of the continent. You have to face not only the challenges and dangers of the wild lands, because the world in which the events of the game unfold is full of internecine strife, political intrigues, racial hatred and discrimination.

[From [url=https://purplegray.itch.io/dwurrindaine-the-widows-swamp]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]《Dwurrindaine: The Widow’s Swamp》[/b]是我的新游戏项目，故事发生在一个虚构的奇幻世界中，你将扮演一位领地守护者。你受命管理一处偏远聚落“杜林戴恩”，这个名字在矮人语中意为“寡妇沼泽”。这里是大陆上最危险、最死寂、最缺乏探索的地区之一。你要面对的还不只是蛮荒之地的挑战与危险，因为游戏所描绘的世界也充斥着内部纷争、政治阴谋、种族仇恨与歧视。

[摘自[url=https://purplegray.itch.io/dwurrindaine-the-widows-swamp]Itch.io[/url]]
